cover_title: 7 'next step' traps that cost interns EMREE marks
cover_sub: You know the diagnosis. The mark is in what you do first.
slides: Needle decompression BEFORE any chest X-ray.
It's a clinical diagnosis. Imaging first wastes the minutes they don't have.
It protects the myocardium. It does not lower K+. Shift it next with insulin-dextrose.
Insulin drives K+ into cells and can trigger an arrhythmia.
Antibiotics now. Don't wait for CT or LP.
Take blood cultures, then treat. A delayed LP never justifies delayed antibiotics.
IM adrenaline 0.5 mg (1 mg/mL), anterolateral thigh.
Not IV as first line. Not an antihistamine first. Repeat after 5 min if no better.
Methotrexate and expectant management are for stable patients only.
Endoscopy within 24 h is for stable patients. Unstable can't wait.
